name: kit
description: A Claude Code kit that trains the person asking. The MENTOR coaches how each request was framed before the work runs, then grades the ask out of 100 — framing, leverage, and learnings applied — into an append-only ledger per repo. The CRITIC judges the work in fresh context and its own words: did the thing you ASKED for actually happen, was each claim backed by a check that could have failed, did it stay in scope. It records a VERDICT rather than a score, and every future critic is handed the last one so a recurring fault gets named. The SCORECARD renders the ledger as a published board with XP, levels, streaks and badges. Two process skills travel with it: CLOUDFLEET (the coordinator splits the backlog across parallel cloud sessions and integrates what comes back) and ONEHELM (a root fix owes three answers — the fact, how many places decide it before and after, and the check that goes red on a second — or it says THIS IS A PATCH). Every process word is indexed in PROCESSES.md. And three for the work itself: BACKLOG (ids in, a fix closes its ticket in its own commit, closed tickets swept out — bin/backlog.mjs), BUG (`bug:` = file it in their words, then fix it) and UPDATES (the page the operator judges each build on — bin/updates.mjs).
